<quote by="Announced by D'ardante, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">To build the School of Hard Knocks in Temeschwar, using 20 wains of white granite. Creating the title 'Maestro of Wolves' appointed by unanimous decision of League senators.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] in [[Temeschwar]]  as per the opportunity presented in the '''[[Schools_and_sawmills#School_of_Hard_Knocks|Schools and sawmills]]''' wind of fortune.
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]
==Date==
* Autumn 385YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 20 wains of white granite
* 60 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|School_of_Hard_Knocks_in_Temeschwar}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete the [[Master of the Sword Academy of Temeschwar]] will be available to be elected by the [[senator|senators]] of [[the League]] for the first time at the Winter Solstice 385YE
